RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The composition of the panel tells you almost nothing. A woman was selected over you, another woman, so sex can't easily explain the outcome — and an all-women panel of four is unremarkable in a sector where risk and regulatory teams are increasingly mixed. Raising it would likely read as grievance-driven and undermine your credibility on the points that do have substance.

Those points are stronger: a candidate with a master's and vaguer "broad experience" was preferred over a PhD with nine years of direct modelling experience, and your written request has gone unanswered for two weeks. Chase that in writing, ask what criteria were weighted, and keep age in mind as a more plausible line of enquiry than sex.
